place_fields.micro_region: Male Mahadeshwara Hills, Chamarajanagar district, Karnataka
place_fields.vibe: Pilgrimage shrine in a forested Eastern Ghats hill setting
place_fields.summary: Sri Male Mahadeshwara Temple is the main shrine at Male Mahadeshwara Hills, a major pilgrimage centre in the Chamarajanagar district. Karnataka Tourism describes the hill as being surrounded by dense forest and notes sacred steps and trails around the shrine.

planning_attributes.description: Ancient shrine dedicated to Lord Shiva in the form of Mahadeshwara, situated on the summit area of Male Mahadeshwara Hills.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Karnataka Tourism associates the shrine with Sri Male Mahadeshwara Swamy, who is traditionally placed in the 15th century, and describes a history spanning more than six centuries.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Karnataka Tourism states that the hill is accessible by road from Kollegal and Mysuru, with KSRTC buses and private taxis serving the hill summit; Mysuru is the nearest major railhead listed there.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The temple has specific darshan timings; Karnataka Tourism also advises visitors to follow local restrictions on sacred trails and to observe the protected wildlife-area setting.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The surrounding hills are part of a wildlife sanctuary. Visitors should avoid unnecessary noise and littering; Karnataka Tourism also notes enforced vehicle speed limits in the wildlife zone.
planning_attributes.local_name_variants: Male Mahadeshwara Hills; MM Hills; Sri Male Mahadeshwara Temple
planning_attributes.notes: Temple-run dharmashalas and basic guest houses are available near the complex, according to Karnataka Tourism.

place_fields.summary: Haralukote Shri Anjaneya Swamy Temple is a listed Hindu temple in Chamarajanagar; current directory evidence identifies the place by name and location in Chamarajanagar.

planning_attributes.description: Hindu temple dedicated to Anjaneya (Hanuman), identified in current Chamarajanagar business listings as Haralukote Shri Anjaneya Swamy Temple.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The available listing places the temple in Chamarajanagar; detailed route information was not independently established from an authoritative first-party source.
planning_attributes.local_name_variants: Haralukote Shri Anjaneya Swamy Temple; Haralū Kote Anjaneyaswamy Temple
planning_attributes.notes: Current directory evidence lists the temple in Chamarajanagar and provides no verified business hours.

place_fields.vibe: Quiet Hoysala heritage monument and architectural site
place_fields.summary: The Chennakesava Temple at Somanathapura is a major surviving Hoysala monument. UNESCO includes the Keshava Temple at Somanathapura in the Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas World Heritage property, while Karnataka Tourism describes its detailed carvings and star-shaped raised platform.

planning_attributes.description: A 13th-century Hoysala temple complex at Somanathapura, built in 1268 CE by Somanatha Dandanayaka and dedicated to Chennakesava, a form of Vishnu.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Karnataka Tourism dates construction to 1268 CE under Hoysala King Narasimha III's commander Somanatha Dandanayaka. UNESCO identifies the Keshava Temple at Somanathapura as one of the three representative temple complexes in the Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Karnataka Tourism states that Somanathapura is about 35 km from Mysuru and can be combined with nearby heritage destinations such as Talakad and Shivanasamudra.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Karnataka Tourism states that no active worship takes place in the temple and visitors can closely observe the architectural details; current visitor arrangements should still be followed on site.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The site is primarily a heritage monument; visitors should avoid touching or climbing carved surfaces and follow site-management instructions.
planning_attributes.local_name_variants: Somanathapura Temple; Chennakesava Temple; Keshava Temple, Somanathapura
planning_attributes.notes: The monument is protected by the Archaeological Survey of India, according to Karnataka Tourism.
